verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-002 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-002: roles and capabilities are never read from request data; capability sets are static rules per principal type
quotes: "producer claiming every project while persisted as granted-projects",
verdicts.why: The check detects attempts to elevate persisted staff or service scope using caller-supplied claims, and it verifies static capability restrictions for administrators, operators, viewers, and service principals.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-005, INV-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-005: a revoked grant, credential, viewer, or session blocks the next authorization check immediately, per the revocation cascade table
INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
verdicts.why: It detects revoked staff/viewer sessions, a revoked viewer, revoked viewer/producer grants, suspended or disabled staff with sessions, and a disabled service principal. It does not test revoked credentials or prove that disabled service principals and disabled staff have no usable credentials.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-029 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-029 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
quotes: "producer without a grant for this project",
"producer claiming every project while persisted as granted-projects",
verdicts.why: The check asserts authorization according to persisted GRANTED_PROJECTS versus ALL_PROJECTS scope and active or revoked grants. It supplies no import content and does not assert that authorization occurs before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-007 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-007: viewer capabilities are read-only; a viewer can never mutate portal data or access management
verdicts.why: It verifies that a viewer can use a read capability and is rejected for one mutation capability. It does not attempt viewer access management or comprehensively assert that every viewer capability is read-only.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-001, INV-017, PLAT-REG-003 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
statements: INV-001: every project-scoped operation passes the guard sequence: valid session, active principal, project access, required capability, Registry lifecycle policy; first failure wins

INV-017: an operator may access a project only through one active StaffProjectAssignment; revocation blocks the next project-scoped authorization check immediately; current administrators derive project scope from the single administrative area policy
PLAT-REG-003: a linked mutation succeeds only after server-side typed validation reports the same UUID as active
verdicts.why: The check exercises session, active-principal, assignment/scope, capability, and Registry lifecycle failures, including revoked assignment behavior, administrator scope without an assignment, and one scope-before-lifecycle case. It does not fully prove first-failure ordering, uniqueness of active staff assignments, or reject a Registry validation result whose returned UUID differs from the requested UUID.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
statements: PLAT-REG-006: the portal stores no Registry snapshot as current truth; live context is fetched through the gateway; archived context stays readable but grants no mutation permission
verdicts.why: It verifies that archived Registry context remains readable while mutation is rejected, through the substituted Registry boundary. It does not assert absence of a stored Registry snapshot or that live context is fetched afresh rather than treated as cached current truth.
